# probable

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:probable`](gmeow-probable.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/probable>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md), [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Likely true according to the standpoint — held more strongly than merely possible, but short of settled ([CRMinf](../../external/ontologies.md#target-crminf) belief value 'probable').

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:StandpointModality`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointModality.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:probable`](gmeow-probable.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:StandpointModality`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointModality.md).
